Clear some space and get to work with me. This military-style bodyweight workout combines push-ups, squats, lunges, core exercises, and conditioning movements into one session you can do at home, in the barracks, or wherever you’ve got room to move.
We’re working on muscular endurance, full-body conditioning, and putting in quality reps when you’re getting tired. I’m right there doing the workout with you.
WORKOUT FORMAT
• 20 minutes
• 40 seconds of work / 20 seconds of rest
• 20 different exercises—no repeats
• No equipment required
